text.offer: You have proven yourself a disciple of Shal'ille. One of our healers would walk the world beside you, tending your wounds and those of your friends. Ask me for a companion, and they will swear to you in Shal'ille's light.
text.progress: Stand before Shal'ille's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: Keep your healer close and they will keep you standing. Your bond will grow with every battle you share.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
steps.brief: Stand before Shal'ille's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
